La Maria in Schwaz

** Discover authentic Tyrolean charm at **La Maria** in **Schwaz**, a cozy mountain inn nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this family-run gem offers warm hospitality and hearty Alpine cuisine in a rustic setting. Savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, and homemade strudel, paired with local craft beers and fine wines. The inn’s sun terrace invites you to unwind with a glass of **Grüner Veltliner** while soaking in the breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring **Schwaz’s** historic old town, return to **La Maria** for a relaxing evening by the crackling fireplace. Whether you’re seeking adventure or tranquility, this retreat promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Tirol**.
